items.text: Grashaus Projects, funded by Sanity Group Switzerland and run by the Swiss Institute for Addiction and Health Research, sells cannabis to enrolled participants through specialised shops in Liestal and Allschwil. Planned from November 2023 to October 2028, with up to 3,950 participants.

Under the federal pilot-trial rules, only adults who live in this canton and can show they already use cannabis may enrol. Participants may use the products only themselves: no passing them on and no use in publicly accessible places. Visitors from outside the canton can't enrol or buy, and the national cannabis ban applies to everyone outside the trials. Each trial is limited to five years, with one extension of up to two years possible; the legal basis for the trials ends on 14 May 2031.

Federal-approved cannabis pilot trial here: Grashaus Projects: structured, controlled sale in Liestal and Allschwil. Pilot trials are scientific studies approved by the federal health office; organisers report to it yearly.

laws.rule: Basel-Landschaft's rest-day law (Ruhetagsgesetz, §§ 2, 4 and 6): public rest days are Sundays; the general holidays (New Year's Day, Easter Monday, 1 May, Ascension, Whit Monday, 1 August, the Federal Day of Prayer, and St Stephen's Day); and the high holidays (Good Friday, Easter Sunday, Whit Sunday and Christmas Day). Communes may add further holidays. On Sundays and general holidays, activities and events that disturb the public quiet by noise or otherwise are banned, as is disturbing a church service and unsolicited door-to-door selling; the noise ban does not apply on 1 May or 1 August. On high holidays, non-religious public assemblies and processions, sports events, outdoor cinema, theatre and music, circuses and other shows, commercially run exhibitions, shooting, fireworks and car washes are also banned, unless the event has a concrete link to that holiday. The Regierungsrat may allow an indoor sports event of more than regional importance (§ 6bis). An exception permit under § 5 may cost CHF 50 to CHF 1,000 (about A$86 to A$1,727).
